# Triumph Expands Intelligence as a Platform with Transfix as Inaugural Partner


November 17, 2026 8:35am EST


*New offering enables transportation companies to build products and insights using Intelligence from the Triumph Network*


DALLAS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Triumph Financial, Inc.](https://triumph.io/) (NYSE: TFIN) today announced an expansion of Triumph Intelligence that enables customers to integrate data from the Triumph Network directly into their own products and platforms, with[Transfix](https://transfix.io/) as the inaugural partner.


This press release features multimedia. View the full release here:[https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261117402261/en/](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261117402261/en/)


Triumph and Transfix partner to advance freight intelligence.


Under the agreement, Triumph will provide anonymized market reference data from the Triumph Network to Transfix. Transfix will combine Triumph’s data with information from its custom models to develop intelligence that will be made available to participating customers. Mutual customers of Triumph Intelligence and Transfix will be able to access the combined model on both platforms.


The Triumph Network provides the financial infrastructure that connects brokers, carriers, shippers and factors across the freight ecosystem. Through payments, factoring, banking and intelligence, Triumph helps move the money and insights that power freight.


That position gives Triumph a unique source of intelligence grounded in actual freight transactions rather than estimates or workflow activity. Transactions flowing through the Triumph Network provide a high-fidelity view of market pricing and transaction activity that can power better decisions across the industry.


“Triumph Intelligence is becoming more than a product we build for our own customers. It is a platform others can build on,” said Aaron P. Graft, founder and chief executive officer of Triumph. “Transfix is building innovative cost models, and I admire the way they are using data to serve the freight market. I am proud to have them as our first platform partner and excited to see what they build with Triumph Intelligence.”


“The quality of freight intelligence starts with the quality of the data behind it,” said Jonathan Salama, co-founder and CEO of Transfix. “When we evaluated potential data partners, Triumph stood out for the quality of its data and its reputation in the transportation industry. Grounded in actual transactions, Triumph’s data provides unmatched visibility into actual market activity, creating a strong foundation for the models and insights we deliver to our customers.”


The agreement with Transfix represents the first application of Triumph’s intelligence platform strategy, creating a model that extends Triumph Intelligence through additional products, platforms and partnerships across the freight industry.


**About Triumph**


Triumph (NYSE: TFIN) is a transportation-focused financial and technology company that delivers payments, factoring, banking and intelligence solutions designed to simplify and modernize freight transactions for brokers, carriers, shippers and factors. The company develops technology and financial products that improve operational efficiency, increase transparency and security in transactions, and expand access to working capital across the transportation industry. Headquartered in Dallas, Texas, Triumph's portfolio includes Triumph, LoadPay and TBK Bank.


Through Triumph Intelligence, the company transforms the scale and operational depth of the Triumph Network into actionable freight market intelligence. Built on transaction-backed data from a network touching approximately 65% of brokered freight and supporting more than $40 billion in annual carrier payments, Triumph Intelligence provides pricing, capacity, volume, margin and market trend insights that help transportation companies make more informed business decisions. Learn more at[www.triumph.io](http://www.triumph.io/) .


**About Transfix**


Transfix, Inc. is a leading transportation technology company modernizing how freight moves. Built from over a decade of brokerage expertise, the Transfix TMS connects pricing, planning, and performance in one intelligent platform. Powered by AI-driven cost models, dynamic control panels, and real-time market insights, Transfix helps brokers and 3PLs price smarter, operate faster, and perform more profitably—all without piecing together multiple tools. From predictive rate forecasting to end-to-end load management, Transfix delivers the intelligence and automation brokers need to stay ahead in a dynamic market—while ensuring their data remains proprietary and secure.
